```{r}
Trialless <- read_csv("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/R_outputs/Trialless.csv")
add_layers <- function(Data, depthpath) {
  list_of_depth <- list.files(
    path = depthpath,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  depth <- read_csv(list_of_depth, id = "id", col_names = F)
  depth <- depth %>%
    mutate(id = str_extract(depth$id, "M\\d+_\\d+")) %>%
    rename("surface" = X1)


  Layerd <- Data %>%
    separate_wider_delim(cluster_id2, delim = "_", names = c("del", "Mouse", "Day"), cols_remove = F) %>%
    unite("id", c(Mouse, Day)) %>%
    select(!del) %>%
    left_join(depth) %>%
    replace_na(list(surface = 950)) %>%
    mutate(dist_surf = surface - depth) %>%
    mutate(Layer_fine = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 50) ~ "L1",
      between(dist_surf, 50, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 750) ~ "L5A",
      between(dist_surf, 750, 1050) ~ "L5B",
      between(dist_surf, 1050, 1210) ~ "L6",
      .default = "bad"
    )) %>%
    mutate(Layer = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 1210) ~ "L5",
      .default = "bad"
    ))
  Layerd
}
```

```{r}
  ))



# duplicate data, to show average
Zeta_Trialless <- Zeta_Trialless %>% bind_rows(
  Zeta_Trialless %>%
    mutate(res1 = 2)
)


# plot
Plot_data <- Zeta_Trialless %>%
  mutate(res1 = case_when(
    res1 == 0 ~ "non responsive",
    res1 == 1 ~ "responsive",
    res1 == 2 ~ "average"
  )) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.04)) %>%
  group_by(Behv, res1, cluster_id2) %>%

  ) +
```

# compare against expected value
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

datapath <- "H:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/Zetatests"
list_of_data <- list.files(
  path = datapath,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = T
)
Data <- read_csv(list_of_data, id = "Behv")
# extract id from filename, remove videos with more than 2 missing frames
Data_all <- Data %>%
  mutate(Behv = str_extract(Behv, "(?<=/)[^/]+(?=\\.csv$)")) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv == "W2T", "HIT", Behv)) %>%
  unite("unit", c(unit, Mouse, Day)) %>%
  select(-`...1`)
Data_all <- Data_all %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_val,method = "BH")) 

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 10000
alpha <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Build the complete unit × behavior response matrix
# ============================================================

signals <- Data_all %>%
  distinct(Behv) %>%
  pull(Behv) %>%
  sort()

significant <- Data_all %>%
  filter(p_adj < alpha, Behv %in% signals) %>%
  distinct(unit, Behv) %>%
  mutate(response = 1L)

X_full <- Data_all %>%
  distinct(unit) %>%
  crossing(Behv = signals) %>%
  left_join(significant, by = c("unit", "Behv")) %>%
  mutate(response = replace_na(response, 0L)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Behv, values_from = response) %>%
  column_to_rownames("unit") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ============================================================
# Permutation functions
# ============================================================

# Randomize response membership independently for each behavior
# while preserving the observed number of responsive units per behavior.
randomize_membership <- function(X) {
  
  n_units <- nrow(X)
  n_positive <- colSums(X)
  
  X_random <- sapply(
    n_positive,
    \(n) sample(c(rep.int(1L, n), rep.int(0L, n_units - n)))
  )
  
  X_random <- as.matrix(X_random)
  colnames(X_random) <- colnames(X)
  rownames(X_random) <- rownames(X)
  
  X_random
}

# Two-sided permutation p-value:
# proportion of null values at least as far from the null mean as observed.
permutation_p_value <- function(null_values, observed) {
  
  null_mean <- mean(null_values)
  
  (1 + sum(abs(null_values - null_mean) >= abs(observed - null_mean))) /
    (length(null_values) + 1)
}

# Select the exact combinations displayed in the exact-overlap plot.
select_exact_patterns <- function(result, min_observed = 5, max_patterns = 12) {
  
  result$exact %>%
    filter(observed >= min_observed) %>%
    slice_max(observed, n = max_patterns, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(desc(observed)) %>%
    mutate(
      pattern = factor(pattern, levels = pattern),
      pattern_label = str_replace_all(as.character(pattern), " & ", "\n")
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Run observed-versus-expected overlap analysis
# ============================================================

run_overlap_analysis <- function(X, n_perm = 10000) {
  
  n_units <- nrow(X)
  signals <- colnames(X)
  n_signals <- ncol(X)
  
  # Integer codes for all possible exact response combinations.
  # With four behaviors, this gives 2^4 = 16 possible combinations.
  pattern_codes <- 0:(2^n_signals - 1)
  
  pattern_labels <- map_chr(pattern_codes, \(code) {
    included <- signals[bitwAnd(code, 2^(0:(n_signals - 1))) != 0]
    
    if (length(included) == 0) "None" else str_c(included, collapse = " & ")
  })
  
  get_pattern_code <- function(X) {
    as.vector(X %*% 2^(0:(ncol(X) - 1)))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Observed counts
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  observed_exact <- tibble(
    pattern = factor(
      pattern_labels[get_pattern_code(X) + 1],
      levels = pattern_labels
    )
  ) %>%
    count(pattern, name = "observed") %>%
    complete(
      pattern = factor(pattern_labels, levels = pattern_labels),
      fill = list(observed = 0)
    )
  
  observed_multiplicity <- tibble(
    n_responses = rowSums(X)
  ) %>%
    count(n_responses, name = "observed") %>%
    complete(
      n_responses = 0:n_signals,
      fill = list(observed = 0)
    )
  
  pair_indices <- combn(seq_len(n_signals), 2)
  
  pair_info <- tibble(
    signal_1 = signals[pair_indices[1, ]],
    signal_2 = signals[pair_indices[2, ]],
    pair = str_c(
      signals[pair_indices[1, ]],
      signals[pair_indices[2, ]],
      sep = " & "
    )
  )
  
  observed_pairwise <- crossprod(X)[
    cbind(pair_indices[1, ], pair_indices[2, ])
  ]
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Allocate permutation-result storage
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  null_exact <- matrix(
    0L,
    nrow = n_perm,
    ncol = length(pattern_labels)
  )
  
  null_multiplicity <- matrix(
    0L,
    nrow = n_perm,
    ncol = n_signals + 1
  )
  
  null_pairwise <- matrix(
    0L,
    nrow = n_perm,
    ncol = ncol(pair_indices)
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Permutations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    
    X_null <- randomize_membership(X)
    
    null_exact[b, ] <- tabulate(
      get_pattern_code(X_null) + 1,
      nbins = length(pattern_labels)
    )
    
    null_multiplicity[b, ] <- tabulate(
      rowSums(X_null) + 1,
      nbins = n_signals + 1
    )
    
    overlap_matrix <- crossprod(X_null)
    
    null_pairwise[b, ] <- overlap_matrix[
      cbind(pair_indices[1, ], pair_indices[2, ])
    ]
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Summaries and raw permutation p-values
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  exact_comparison <- observed_exact %>%
    mutate(
      expected = colMeans(null_exact),
      expected_lower = apply(null_exact, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
      expected_upper = apply(null_exact, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975),
      p_value = map_dbl(
        seq_along(observed),
        \(i) permutation_p_value(null_exact[, i], observed[i])
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(pattern != "None") %>%
    arrange(desc(observed)) %>%
    mutate(pattern = factor(pattern, levels = pattern))
  
  multiplicity_comparison <- observed_multiplicity %>%
    mutate(
      expected = colMeans(null_multiplicity),
      expected_lower = apply(null_multiplicity, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
      expected_upper = apply(null_multiplicity, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975),
      p_value = map_dbl(
        seq_along(observed),
        \(i) permutation_p_value(null_multiplicity[, i], observed[i])
      )
    )
  
  pairwise_comparison <- pair_info %>%
    mutate(
      observed = observed_pairwise,
      expected = colMeans(null_pairwise),
      expected_lower = apply(null_pairwise, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
      expected_upper = apply(null_pairwise, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975),
      p_value = map_dbl(
        seq_along(observed),
        \(i) permutation_p_value(null_pairwise[, i], observed[i])
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(observed)) %>%
    mutate(pair = factor(pair, levels = pair))
  
  list(
    exact = exact_comparison,
    multiplicity = multiplicity_comparison,
    pairwise = pairwise_comparison,
    n_units = n_units,
    n_perm = n_perm
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Plot functions
# ============================================================

plot_exact <- function(result, min_observed = 5, max_patterns = 12) {
  
  plot_data <- select_exact_patterns(
    result,
    min_observed = min_observed,
    max_patterns = max_patterns
  )
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pattern)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(y = observed),
      fill = "grey25",color="black",
      width = 0.7,alpha=0.4
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = expected_lower, ymax = expected_upper),
      colour = "firebrick",
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(y = expected),
      colour = "firebrick",
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = plot_data$pattern_label) +
    labs(
      x = "Exact response combination",
      y = "Number of units",
      title = "Observed versus expected response overlap",
      caption = "Black bars: observed; red points and intervals: permutation-null mean and 95% interval"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey40")
    )+
    geom_text(
      aes(y = observed, label = observed),
      vjust = -0.35,
      size = 4
    ) 
}

plot_multiplicity <- function(result) {
  
  ggplot(result$multiplicity, aes(factor(n_responses))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = observed), fill = "grey25", width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = expected_lower, ymax = expected_upper),
      colour = "firebrick",
      width = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(y = expected), colour = "firebrick", size = 3) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of significant behaviors per unit",
      y = "Number of units",
      title = "Observed versus expected response multiplicity"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_pairwise <- function(result) {
  
  ggplot(result$pairwise, aes(pair)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = observed), fill = "grey25", width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = expected_lower, ymax = expected_upper),
      colour = "firebrick",
      width = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(y = expected), colour = "firebrick", size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = "Signal pair",
      y = "Units responsive to both signals",
      title = "Observed versus expected pairwise overlap"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}
```
